Create a new entry with a randomly generated value

Usage:
  gage generate [OPTIONS] <title>

Arguments:
  <title>  

Options:
  -c, --clip                copy the generated value to the clipboard, and clear it after a timeout
      --description <TEXT>  optional description
  -f, --force               allow inserting a duplicate title
  -l, --length <N>          length of the generated value (default 24, minimum 8)
      --no-symbols          draw from letters and digits only
  -q, --qr                  render the generated value as a QR code
  -u, --use <NAME>          vault to operate on (default: the current vault)
  -h, --help                Print help
